## Description {#details}

<p><a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/classes/llvm/optimizationremarkemitter">OptimizationRemarkEmitter</a> legacy analysis pass.</p>


<p>Note that this pass shouldn't generally be marked as preserved by other passes. It's holding onto BFI, so if the pass does not preserve BFI, BFI could be freed.</p>


<p>Definition at line 145 of file <a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/files/include/include/llvm/include/llvm/analysis/optimizationremarkemitter-h">OptimizationRemarkEmitter.h</a>.</p>
